entries.name: No dynamic fee
entries.description: Fare stays at the meter fare (autos) or base fare (bikes); no captain incentive.

entries.name: Flat mid fee
entries.description: A constant mid-level fee everywhere: x1.2 on bikes and scooters, +Rs10 boost on autos.

entries.name: Flat incentive
entries.description: No fee, but every captain trip gets a flat Rs8 incentive everywhere.

entries.name: Rule (default)
entries.description: Fee and incentive follow the local demand/supply ratio, textbook thresholds.

entries.name: Rule (tuned)
entries.description: Same rule, six thresholds found by random search on separate days.

entries.name: Neural policy
entries.description: Shared MLP over ward features choosing fee and incentive level: behaviour-cloned from the rule, then evolution-strategies fine-tuned.
